_comment: Spec row -> covering bench or non-bench artifact (issue #28). A test checks every row of spec/target-spec.md appears here. status: runnable = bench builds and runs against the stand-in; blocked = waits on a named item; not-a-bench = covered by a corner file or another T1 item.

1.note: operating point; BENCH_F0_HZ picks the column

3.note: structural: 8 output taps tap0..tap7 plus reference tap8, checked by a unit test

4.note: schematic result only; post-layout is a separate recorded result (row 11 / other T1 items)

6.blocked_on: the noise method is fixed by spec/decisions/0014-row-6-noise-method.md (proposed, validated by sim/noise-method); the DLL jitter deck itself does not exist

9.note: supply and device flavor are the corner set and the pinned PDK (sim/pdk.json)

10.note: the stand-in draws no supply current; meaningful only on the item-1 netlist

11.artifact: klt drc / klt lvs / klt pex

12.note: end-of-run LOCK graded against the row-8 verdict in every run (verdict and exit code); the 128-cycle latency is graded in sim/lock-time from the ls_* samples (16-cycle resolution)
